'''Drelliad Village''' was a small settlement on the northern coast of the island of [[Avilatan]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
{{Quote|This village used to be safe, but the separatists are taking over. If I were you I'd haul jets as soon as we're done.|[[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] speaking to [[Voidhound]]|<ref name="Codex" />}}
Drelliad Village was founded several decades before the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] as the private retreat of [[Ulla Drelliad]], a famous [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. After Drelliad's death, the retreat became a successful trading post. During the [[Separatist War|Ord Mantell Civil War]], the village became a hotly contested area, as [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|separatist]] forces [[Battle in Drelliad village|battled]] for control of the landing pad that used to be the personal docking bay of Ulla herself. As the village's docking bay was one of the only landing pads outside of the Republic's [[Fort Garnik]], the village was a strategically important location.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drelliad Village, along with the rest of Avilatan, was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. Drelliad serves as the starting location for both the [[Republic trooper]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] classes.<ref name="TOR" />
